# Unit test for function solve
def test_solve():
    # No alphabetic characters -> reversed string
    assert solve("1234") == "4321"
    assert solve("!@#$%") == "%$#@!"
    assert solve("") == ""

    # Alphabetic characters -> swapcase each letter
    assert solve("ab") == "AB"
    assert solve("AB") == "ab"
    assert solve("aBcD") == "AbCd"
    assert solve("Hello World") == "hELLO wORLD"

    # Mixed alphanumeric/special characters -> swapcase, non-alpha preserved
    assert solve("#a@C") == "#A@c"
    assert solve("#As@W") == "#aS@w"
    assert solve("123aBc!") == "123AbC!"

    # Unicode letters are also swapped
    assert solve("éÀ") == "Éà"

def test_solve():
    # Case swapping of alphabetic characters
    assert solve("ab") == "AB"
    assert solve("aBcD") == "AbCd"
    assert solve("#a@C") == "#A@c"
    assert solve("Hello World!") == "hELLO wORLD!"
    
    # No alphabetic characters: string is reversed
    assert solve("1234") == "4321"
    assert solve("12345!@#$%") == "%$#@!54321"
    assert solve("!!") == "!!"
    
    # Edge cases
    assert solve("") == ""           # empty string -> reversed empty string
    assert solve("a") == "A"         # single lowercase letter
    assert solve("Z") == "z"         # single uppercase letter
    assert solve("7") == "7"         # single digit (no alpha -> reversed, same)
    assert solve("_") == "_"         # single non-alpha char
    assert solve("a1b2") == "A1B2"   # mixed alpha/digits
    assert solve("  ") == "  "       # spaces only (no alpha -> reversed, same)
    assert solve(" Hello ") == " hELLO "  # spaces preserved, letters swapped
